cohort: 175 newborns, classified into Small for Gestational Age (n=87) or Appropriate for Gestational Age (n=88) based on their gestational age and birth weight, from a single tertiary hospital.
finding: Elevated umbilical cord GH levels and decreased umbilical cord IGF-1 levels were significantly associated with an increased risk of Small for Gestational Age (SGA).
mod_finding: Cesarean section had a significantly positive association with neonatal birth weight.
birth_weight: Not explicitly specified as an inclusion criterion; newborns were classified as SGA or AGA based on birth weight percentiles for gestational age.
gest_age: Not explicitly specified as an inclusion criterion; newborns were classified as SGA or AGA based on gestational age percentiles for birth weight.
